need.ce: Showing the machines without a CE declaration on file
need.checks: Showing the machines with a statutory check overdue

held.noMachines: No machine on screen to tag
held.noneToTag: The machines selected are retired: their tag reports nothing
held.noManage: Changed by a role that keeps the machines (plant.machines.manage)
held.retired: A retired machine keeps its last status
held.locked: Locked as unsafe: its request's sign-safe frees it
held.sameStatus: It is in this status already

keys.printTags: Print QR tags (the selection, else the rows on screen)

wall.title: Status wall
wall.failed: The status wall couldn't be read
wall.empty: Register the machines in Machines & tools: each shows here with its live status.
wall.truncated: This wall shows the first 1000 machines: pick one site.
wall.foot: Live: a tile changes as soon as its machine does. A tile opens the machine.

status.title: Change the status of {machine}

choiceHint.RUNNING: It works and may be used
choiceHint.DOWN: Stopped: it does not work now
choiceHint.DO_NOT_USE: Nobody may use it until a technician releases it

status.reasonHint: Kept in the machine's history (no person is named there).
status.lockedBody: Only a technician's sign-safe on the request that locked it frees this machine (Owner answer H1). Open the request in Machine requests.
status.doNotUseTitle: Do not use needs a reason
status.doNotUseBody: Only a technician releases it, with a fresh authenticator code.
status.releaseBody: A technician's act: a fresh authenticator code is asked when you confirm.
status.releaseHeldBody: Your role cannot release a do-not-use machine: ask a technician (plant.signSafe).
status.cancelled: No code given: the status did not change.

stepUp.title: Confirm with your authenticator
stepUp.release: Releasing a machine marked do-not-use is a technician's act: type the six-digit code your authenticator shows now.
stepUp.wrong: That code is wrong or used: type the one showing now.
stepUp.locked: Too many tries: wait a moment.
stepUp.unavailable: The code couldn't be checked: try again.

refusal.MACHINE_RETIRED: This machine is retired: its status no longer changes.
refusal.SAME_STATUS: The machine is in this status already.
refusal.LOCKED_UNSAFE: Locked as unsafe: it stays do-not-use until a technician signs its request safe.
refusal.DOCUMENT_KIND: A CE declaration or a manual is a document; a photo goes under Photos.
refusal.TAG_RETIRED: retired: its tag no longer offers Report a problem
refusal.TAG_OTHER_SITE: stands at another site than the printer

docs.forbidden: Your role does not see this machine's documents.
docs.notFound: It does not exist, or you may not see it.
docs.noCeBody: Upload the CE declaration first: D.Lgs. 81/2008 art. 71 asks for it, with the manuals, at hand.
docs.noCeBodyRead: Ask whoever keeps the machines to upload it: D.Lgs. 81/2008 art. 71 asks for it at hand.
docs.empty: Upload the CE declaration first, then the manuals.
docs.groupEmptyCe: Missing: upload the declaration of conformity.

held.notAvailable: Not available yet (the upload or the scan is not done)
held.noManage: Removed by a role that keeps the machines (plant.machines.manage)
held.reason: Say why, in a few words
held.manualPdf: A manual is a PDF: file a photo under Photos.
held.photoImage: A photo is an image (JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC).

docs.uploadHeld: Documents are added by a role that keeps the machines (plant.machines.manage).
docs.tabletsHint: Art. 71: the manuals at hand where the machine works.
docs.law: Paper today: this tab says what is missing; nothing stops a machine without it.
docs.removeBody: A wrong or superseded file leaves the machine's documents; the reason is kept.
docs.removeCeBody: Without it the machine shows No CE declaration on file again; the reason is kept.

history.totals: Time in each status this week
history.noneThisWeek: Nothing to draw this week (registered later, or a week to come).
history.foot: The history starts at the machine's first change; it names no person. Idle comes with machine signals (later).
history.noChanges: No change yet: it has been in its status since it was registered.

tag.title: QR tag
tag.notPrinted: Not on a label printer yet
tag.opensStation: A station's scan: this machine with Report a problem.
tag.opensPhone: A phone camera reads the asset number (the form without sign-in comes later).
tag.opensReprint: A reprint is the same tag: the old one keeps opening the machine.
tag.retired: Retired: its tag no longer offers Report a problem.

tags.title_one: Print the QR tag of {count} machine
tags.title_other: Print the QR tags of {count} machines
tags.sentBody: Each tag's state shows under it: queued, sent, printed or not printed.
tags.printerHint: A label printer of the machines' site.
tags.copiesHint: One for the machine, one spare.
tags.noRightBody: Your role does not send labels to a label printer: print the tag sheet on paper.
tags.noPrinterTitle: No label printer at this site
tags.noPrinterBody: Print the tag sheet on paper, or add a label printer in Admin › Devices & printers.
tags.leftOut_one: Left out: {machines} (retired, or at another site).
tags.leftOut_other: Left out: {machines} (retired, or at another site).
tags.noneBody: Pick machines in the register first.
tags.more_one: and {count} more tag, printed the same way
tags.more_other: and {count} more tags, printed the same way
tags.how: The QR holds the asset number: a station's scan opens the machine with Report a problem.

held.noPrinter: No label printer at this site: print on paper
held.none: No machine here prints on this printer
